result.title: Evaluating Synthetic Skin Lesion Images for Classifier Training: A Safety-Aware Algorithm
result.comment: 57 pages, 12 figures. Code to reproduce all experiments, along with links to the full Zenodo dataset and the synth-curator package, can be found at https://github.com/Amixdu/synth-curator-paper
result.summary: Skin cancer classifiers need large sets of annotated images, which are scarce, especially for rare lesion types. AI-generated images can fill the gap, but a generator produces images of widely varying quality, so selecting which images to retain is important. That choice usually rests on a single quality score, most often the Fréchet Inception Distance (FID), which has not been tested against what a classifier needs and cannot tell whether the generator memorizes its training photographs. We test that practice with a tournament of 16 quality metrics. Each metric alone selects a training subset from a pool of 275,472 images generated by a diffusion model (EDM2), and a classifier trained on each subset scores the metric per class. The tournament shows that no single metric serves every class: FID computed on Inception features gives the best classifier for one lesion type and no measurable advantage over random sampling for another, and the generation setting it prefers is also the one closest to the training images. We turn these per-class measurements into a safety-aware evaluation algorithm that weights each metric by its measured value in each class and removes images too close to a real training image. On the held-out ISIC-2018 test set, the algorithm improves Macro-$F_2$, a recall-weighted measure of classification performance, over the FID baseline for a Swin-B classifier by +0.0136 to +0.0164 across four safety thresholds (Bonferroni-corrected $p < 0.02$) and over random sampling by about +0.03, though not for ResNet-50. Tightening the threshold improves a memorization-safety score with no measurable change in utility, but every curated set remains less safe than random sampling. The results show a modest but statistically significant gain on the primary classifier, and offer a practical, safety-aware procedure for evaluating and using synthetic data.

AI.brief_summary: 论文比较 16 种质量指标各自筛选出的合成皮肤病变图像训练子集对分类器的影响，发现单一指标（如 FID）在不同类别上表现不一致，且偏好更接近真实训练图，进而提出按类别加权并与真实图像保持距离的安全感知筛选算法。
AI.relevance_reason: 工作属于医学图像合成数据质量评估与训练集筛选，既不涉及 VLM 内部视觉表示或 latent 推理状态生成，也不涉及答案对视觉证据的使用；其中的相似度过滤仅用于训练数据清洗，未提供可供核查的推理期证据筛选线索。
